capabilities.nativeFeature: Portable Agent Plugins and repository marketplaces
capabilities.localOverlap: Direct pack projection remains necessary for REPO and IDE discovery during migration.
capabilities.action: Pilot one bounded frontend-design plugin and preserve direct discovery without simultaneous duplicate installation.

capabilities.nativeFeature: Scheduled tasks, monitors, reminders, and later follow-up
capabilities.localOverlap: Repository pollers, retry daemons, and lifecycle hooks would duplicate native scheduling.
capabilities.action: Route explicitly recurring work to native automations and keep repository workflow engines absent.

capabilities.nativeFeature: Task names, pins, sections, forks, and handoff
capabilities.localOverlap: Local status dashboards and handoff files duplicate native task state.
capabilities.action: Use native task ergonomics for long work only when the user requested the corresponding task boundary.

capabilities.nativeFeature: Visible Browser with DOM, console, network, runtime, and profiling evidence
capabilities.localOverlap: Browser reset wrappers and silent headless acceptance duplicate or weaken native Browser control.
capabilities.action: Start visible interactive UI verification early and retain headless checks only as supplemental regression evidence.

capabilities.nativeFeature: Record and Replay for demonstrated Computer Use workflows
capabilities.localOverlap: A repository recorder or browser macro would bypass native consent and availability gates.
capabilities.action: Offer only after a user demonstrates a repetitive workflow; never enable or simulate recording automatically.

capabilities.nativeFeature: GitHub integration, codex review, and approval review
capabilities.localOverlap: General PR wrappers and an always-on custom reviewer duplicate native review surfaces.
capabilities.action: Use native review for routine work and reserve one read-only custom reviewer for high-risk falsification.

capabilities.localOverlap: Framework-side auto-approval would weaken native sandbox and approval ownership.
capabilities.action: Use only when already enabled by the user for an eligible run; never set it from repository policy.

capabilities.nativeFeature: Native subagent lifecycle, model catalog, concurrency, and steering
capabilities.localOverlap: Custom depth routing, forced routine model effort, and lifecycle hooks overrode native ownership.
capabilities.action: Remove the undocumented depth override and routine tester effort pin; retain only narrow architect/reviewer judgment profiles.

capabilities.nativeFeature: Native desktop and CLI import for supported agent setup and recent work
capabilities.localOverlap: A framework importer or conversation migration wrapper would duplicate native import and risk stale or duplicate state.
capabilities.action: Use native import only when the user chooses migration from a supported agent; keep repository bootstrap focused on tracked project configuration.

capabilities.nativeFeature: Opt-in Computer History as a desktop recall and timeline source
capabilities.localOverlap: Memories or activity history cannot safely replace required repository instructions or current provider-visible environment identity.
capabilities.action: Allow Computer History only when natively available and user-enabled; treat it as optional recall and keep durable project authority in tracked instructions.

capabilities.nativeFeature: ChatGPT desktop app preview for supported Linux distributions
capabilities.localOverlap: The framework's shared Desktop and CLI configuration contract remains valid while individual native capabilities vary by surface.
capabilities.action: Preserve one project configuration across surfaces and report unavailable Linux-preview capabilities explicitly instead of adding framework fallbacks.

capabilities.nativeFeature: Daybreak Blue and separately approved Daybreak Red security access tiers
capabilities.localOverlap: Security skills must not choose restricted models, infer offensive authorization, or recreate trusted-access policy.
capabilities.action: Use an approved native tier only inside the exact authorized engagement; Blue approval does not grant Red, and model/access provisioning remains user, workspace, and organization owned.
